candidates.topic: First Quarter Moon in Pisces — Scorpio Season Tension
candidates.teaser: The Moon is in Pisces right now — and it's creating a hidden battle most people don't see coming.
candidates.video_title: First Quarter Moon in Pisces — The Hidden Tension
candidates.video_description: The First Quarter Moon in Pisces clashes with the Scorpio Sun, creating a push-pull between logic and emotion. Here's what that means for you this week.
candidates.script: The Moon is in Pisces right now — and it's fighting the Scorpio Sun in a way most people completely ignore. First Quarter Moons are about tension, action, resistance. But in Pisces, that tension doesn't scream — it dissolves. You feel pulled between what you know and what you sense. Scorpio wants the truth. Pisces wants the dream. If you've felt emotionally exhausted but can't explain why, this square is probably why. Which one are you listening to?

candidates.topic: Three Planets Retrograde — Saturn Uranus Neptune in Late 2026
candidates.teaser: Three planets are retrograde right now — and one of them only does this once every 84 years.
candidates.video_title: 3 Planets Retrograde Right Now — One Changes Everything
candidates.video_description: Saturn, Uranus, and Neptune are all retrograde simultaneously in November 2026. Each one targets a different layer of your life — here's what to know.
candidates.script: Three planets are retrograde right now — and one of them only moves through this sign once in your entire lifetime. Saturn is retrograde in Aries, forcing a reckoning with every structure you built on shaky ground. Uranus is retrograde in Gemini, quietly rewiring how you think and communicate. Neptune is retrograde in Aries — a placement so rare, no one alive has seen it before. These aren't minor transits. They're generational corrections. What in your life has been asking for a full reset?

candidates.topic: Mars and Jupiter Conjunct in Leo — Still at 27°
candidates.teaser: Mars and Jupiter are sitting at nearly the same degree in Leo — and the window to use this energy is almost closed.
candidates.video_title: Mars and Jupiter in Leo — 27° Last Activation Window
candidates.video_description: Mars at 27° Leo and Jupiter at 26° Leo are still conjunct — amplifying ambition, ego, and bold action. This alignment doesn't last much longer.
candidates.script: Mars is at 27 degrees Leo. Jupiter is at 26 degrees Leo. In astrology, when these two planets conjunct, ambition doesn't just rise — it roars. Mars is the drive, Jupiter is the amplifier, and Leo is the stage. This is one of the most action-forward alignments of the year, and it's still active right now. If you've been waiting for the right moment to launch, perform, or lead — astrologers would tell you the window is open. But it won't be for long. Are you a Leo, Aries, or Sagittarius? This one's especially for you.

candidates.topic: The Astrological 9th House — Belief, Travel, Philosophy
candidates.teaser: There's one house in your birth chart that rules everything you believe — and most people have never looked at it.
candidates.video_title: The 9th House — Your Beliefs, Your Worldview, Explained
candidates.video_description: The 9th house rules higher education, long-distance travel, philosophy, and belief systems. Whatever sign sits here shapes how you understand the world.
candidates.script: There's a house in your birth chart that determines what you believe, what you're willing to die for, and how far you'll go — literally and philosophically. It's the 9th house. Ruled by Jupiter and associated with Sagittarius, this is where your worldview lives. It governs long-distance travel, higher education, religion, and the moment your mind cracked open for the first time. Whatever sign sits in your 9th house shapes the lens you use to interpret everything. What's yours?

candidates.topic: Venus in Libra — Late Degree Tension Before Scorpio Entry
candidates.teaser: Venus is at 23° Libra — and when it crosses into Scorpio, the way you experience love shifts completely.
candidates.video_title: Venus at 23° Libra — Love Is About to Change
candidates.video_description: Venus in Libra values harmony, beauty, and balance. But it's approaching Scorpio — where love gets obsessive, deep, and transformative. The shift is close.
candidates.script: Venus is at 23 degrees Libra right now — still craving harmony, beauty, fairness in love. But it's edging toward Scorpio, and in astrology, that crossing changes everything. Libra Venus wants peace. Scorpio Venus wants possession, depth, truth at any cost. When this shift happens, surface-level connections feel unbearable. You'll want real or nothing. If your relationships have felt almost-but-not-quite lately, pay attention to what Venus does next. The comfortable version of love is about to get a lot more intense.
